input.name: formSubmissionSenderEmail
input.label: Sender email address
input.help-text: The "from" address used when sending form submission emails

input.name: formSubmissionReceiverEmail
input.label: Receiver email address
input.help-text: When the form type "E-mail" is selected, the result should be sent to this email

input.name: hideDefaultEmailIntegration
input.label: Hide default email integration
input.help-text: Hide the built-in "Email" form type. Use this when your application provides its own email form type.

input.name: includeStyles
input.label: Include default styles
input.help-text: It is recommended that each website provides its own styles for the forms. But you can include default styles by checking this box.
